title: ntfy topic name written to evidence/WATCHDOG.log by the watchdog's own curl response
found_by: bazalgette, reading the watchdog test output
fix: watchdog.sh now captures the response and logs only the message id; beat.sh redacts curl stderr; v_secrets added to the validator battery as the mechanical guard
lesson: a watchdog that logs what it posts is a watchdog that publishes the doorbell

title: chatcode `tasks claim` returned 'no such task: t-20261021-8511' for a card that `tasks show` could read
rule: NO-STOP-001 §3.6 - an empty or unreadable board is not an empty schedule
detail: load_tasks() lists board/tasks via the contents API; the freshly created card was not in the listing while the direct path read worked. Retried twice after refreshing the clone.
fix: board written direct via the contents API with the lease, branch and an appended history note (R5). Upstream: the claim path should fall back to a direct path read before declaring 'no such task'.

title: Admiralty harmonic constant table for London Bridge not obtainable in this session
rule: §13.5 - amplitudes and phases from published harmonic constants, cited
fix: site constants fitted by least squares to published predicted levels for London Bridge (Tower Pier, PLA gauge 0113); fit residual reported in evidence/TIDE_FIT.json; constituent speeds and equilibrium amplitudes from published tables (R-108, R-109). Provisional against G7's +/-0.15 m, which is evaluated against the same published predictions.

title: FALSE PASS: tools/two_save.sh reported 'CHUNK CENSUS MATCH' after diffing two empty files
found_by: bazalgette, reading the harness instead of trusting it
rule: F22 - a narrow PASS hid a real failure; F15 - census mismatch is an open defect
detail: bl.sh redirected blender stdout into its own log, so the dump text never reached build/cS0000_[ab].txt. diff of two empty files succeeds.
fix: bl.sh now tees blender output through to the caller and REFUSES an empty-output run as a pass. two_save.sh additionally requires a CENSUS_SHA256 line in both dumps before it may print MATCH.
